target: Fire Growth Rate FIGRA = pHRR / t_pHRR from test start (kW/m2/s)
dataset: data/v2/figra_fsri.csv replicate mean per material x flux (spark-ignited, ignition recorded) + mcc_hrr + mcc_extras_fsri + material_props_fsri; materials with MCC (exp012 rows)
model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor x2 (log pHRR, log t_pHRR); FIGRA = exp(a)/exp(b)
note: re-baseline reproduced (0.4563). c1 two-stage (log pHRR / log t_pHRR, HGB) does not meet the 8/10 and ci_lo>=baseline rule. Different population from phan_morgan; no claim vs 0.9724.
